Scatter-Box-Violin Plot Type (David Baranger Style)

Source: R/type_boxplot.R
type_scatter_box_violin.Rd

Creates publication-ready distribution plots layering three complementary representations of data as advocated by David Baranger (2018): 1. A background semi-transparent violin plot showing the probability density and shape of the distribution. 2. A narrow foreground notched boxplot displaying summary statistics (median, 95 3. An overlay of individual jittered raw data points (with black outline and group fill) ensuring complete data transparency. Supports both single-factor and dodged multi-factor groups.

Usage

type_scatter_box_violin(
  notch = TRUE,
  notchwidth = 0.5,
  point_shape = 21,
  point_border = "black",
  point_stroke = 0.35,
  add_violin = TRUE,
  violin_alpha = 0.3,
  violin_width = 0.8,
  violin_color = "black",
  violin_linewidth = 0.55,
  trim = TRUE,
  scale = "width",
  add_jitter = TRUE,
  jitter_width = 0.12,
  jitter_size = 1.8,
  jitter_alpha = 0.65,
  jitter_subsample = NULL,
  width = 0.22,
  alpha = 0.75,
  linewidth = 0.65,
  box_color = "black",
  position_dodge = 0.8,
  outlier_shape = NA,
  outlier_size = 1.5,
  ...
)

Arguments

notch

Logical. Draw notched boxplots showing the 95 around the median (default TRUE in Baranger styles, FALSE otherwise).

notchwidth

Notch depth relative to box width (default `0.5`).

point_shape

Point shape for raw data scatter points. `21` renders filled circles with black borders (default in Baranger style); `16` renders solid circular points (default in classic/pathology styles).

point_border

Border outline color for points when `point_shape` is 21–25 (default `"black"`).

point_stroke

Border stroke thickness for points (default `0.35`).

add_violin

Overlay violin plot (default FALSE for classic/pathology; default TRUE for Baranger style).

violin_alpha

Violin transparency (default 0.20 for classic, 0.30 for baranger).

violin_width

Width of violin layer (default `0.80` for baranger).

violin_color

Outline color of violin layer (`"black"` for baranger, `NA` for classic).

violin_linewidth

Line width of violin outline (default `0.55`).

trim

Logical. Trim violin tails to observed data range (default TRUE).

scale

Density scaling method for violin: `"width"` (default), `"area"`, or `"count"`.

add_jitter

Add jittered points (default TRUE).

jitter_width

Width of jitter (default 0.15 for default, 0.10 for pathology, 0.12 for baranger).

jitter_size

Size of jittered points (default 1.6 for default, 0.85 for pathology, 1.8 for baranger).

jitter_alpha

Transparency of jittered points (default 0.38 for default, 0.35 for pathology, 0.65 for baranger).

jitter_subsample

Optional integer. When specified, subsamples up to `jitter_subsample` observations per category/group for jittered point display while computing boxplots and statistics on all data (ideal for large cohorts such as GTEx with N ~ 20k).

width

Box width (default 0.55 for default, 0.32 for pathology, 0.22 for baranger).

alpha

Box fill transparency (default 0.28 for default, 0.22 for pathology, 0.75 for baranger).

linewidth

Box outline width (default 0.65 for default, 0.45 for pathology).

box_color

Custom outline color for boxplots (default `"black"` for baranger, `"#30343B"` for default, or group-matched for pathology).

position_dodge

Dodge width for grouped boxes. Default 0.8 for default/baranger, 0.42 for pathology style.

outlier_shape

Shape for outlier points. Set to `NA` to hide outliers (publication style). Default `NA`.

outlier_size

Size of outlier points (default 1.5).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

References

Baranger, D. (2018). Showing your data: Scatter, box, & violin plots. https://davidbaranger.com/2018/03/05/showing-your-data-scatter-box-violin-plots/

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Classic Baranger scatter-box-violin plot on single factor
cliplot(Sepal.Length ~ Species, data = iris,
        type = type_scatter_box_violin())

# Grouped / dodged Baranger plot with 2-way layout
cliplot(len ~ dose | supp, data = ToothGrowth,
        type = type_scatter_box_violin(notch = FALSE),
        palette = "nature")
} # }
